description_full: Mama's Creations, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and markets fresh deli-prepared foods in the United States. The company offers chicken, beef and turkey meatballs, meat loaf, sausage-related products, and pasta and rice entrees; olives, olive mixes, and savory products; and hot bars, salad bars, prepared foods, sandwich, and cold deli and foods-to-go sections. It sells its products directly to supermarkets, club chains, mass-market retailers; and food retailer and distributors, as well as through website and social media channels. The company was formerly known as MamaMancini's Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to Mama's Creations, Inc. in August 2023. Mama's Creations, Inc. was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in East Rutherford, New Jersey.

financial_summary: Mama's Creations, Inc. is a small-cap consumer defensive business with a $613M market cap on $172M of annual revenue.

The top line has compounded at +22% over the past three years and +30% annually across the full decade, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder. Operating margins are expanding by +3.7pp year-over-year, which is one of the strongest signals that the moat is deepening.
Returns on capital run at 29% against a 9% cost of capital — a 20-point spread that is the clearest signature of an economic moat, with gross margins sitting at 29%.

The business throws off $10M in free cash flow — roughly 6 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 2.16× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage of 16× is fortress-like.
Net dilution runs at 3.1% annually, transferring value from owners to stock-based comp, and insider ownership is negligible, so management has little personal stake in the long-term outcome.
